text: When a family cancels partway through the year, Scout compares what they've paid this membership year with the covered services they've used.
Remember: read the preview to the owner before you cancel. If they used more than they paid, the difference is charged to their card.
Maria is moving out of our area, and wants to cancel Maple's plan. Click Cancel.
First, the sentence the owner will see. Read it to her.
Paid this membership year, covered services used, and what's left unused. Under the membership agreement, the unused part isn't refunded.
Below that, each payment and each covered service that went into the numbers.
Only if the practice decides to make an exception, tick Refund the unused part, and say why. It's recorded in the audit trail.
Scout confirms what happens: the membership ends now, nothing is charged, and nothing is refunded.
Scout opens Maria's account on the settlement record. The membership is inactive, Stripe billing stops, and she gets an email with the breakdown.

The most common mistakes: cancelling in the Stripe dashboard, which Scout never hears about, and using Cancel when a pet has died. That has its own steps. Remember: read the preview to the owner before you cancel.
